title: Michael in a capsule with floating objects, bumping into Mario on a table
place_text: Aboard craft, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I was in another empty space or capsule or something and I saw things that was flying around, floating around rather

plain: Michael Johnson, a former US Air Force guard, says that around November 1977, near the nuclear missile sites of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he was taken aboard some kind of craft. Telling it on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says he found himself in an empty space or capsule where objects were floating around, and that he came across his fellow guard, Mario Woods, lying on a table. If true, it would mean two guards from a nuclear site were taken aboard something not of this world.
